scenes.title: Três Horas Mais Cedo (Three Hours Early)
scenes.summary: At twelve noon on Saturday, F1 answers a telephone call from the station announcing that the retired mapmaker arrives at three in the afternoon instead of six.

scenes.title: Quatro Bolos até Duas e Meia (Four Cakes by Half Past Two)
scenes.summary: F1 bursts into the café kitchen with the early-train news, and F2 and M4 launch a high-speed relay to bake and cool four berry-and-almond cakes before three.

scenes.title: Chaves Dois e Seis Trocadas (Keys Two and Six Swapped)
scenes.summary: At the front desk, M1 proves from his paper ledger that M2 accidentally handed Room 2's key to Room 6 and Room 6's key to Room 2 while wearing his glasses on his forehead.

scenes.title: Mochilas e uma Caixa de Chapéu (Backpacks and a Hatbox)
scenes.summary: In the upstairs hallway, F3 steps out of Room 4 to help F1 and M1 guide the swapped hallway bags to their proper doors with cheerful welcome cards.

scenes.title: Quatro Mãos em Um Piano (Four Hands at One Piano)
scenes.summary: Inside Room 9, F3 coaches M3 through their joyful four-hand piano duet, helping the careful architect trade strict counting for warm musical flow.

scenes.title: Formas Esfriando na Sombra (Cooling Tins in the Shade)
scenes.summary: At two-fifteen under the courtyard shade tree, F2, M4, and F1 cool the four golden cakes in the breeze and brush on the warm honey-orange glaze.

scenes.title: A Caminho da Plataforma da Estação (Off to the Station Platform)
scenes.summary: At half past two by the street gate, F1 hands M3 and M4 a compass-rose welcome card so the two brothers can greet the retired mapmaker at Central Station.

scenes.title: Passos do Lado de Fora do Portão (Footsteps Outside the Gate)
scenes.summary: At three sharp in the glowing courtyard, M2 checks his glasses on his nose, F2 sets hot mint tea on table one, and the gate bell rings twice as a taxi arrives.
